005package org.wpilib.util.collections;
006
007import java.util.Arrays;
008import java.util.Comparator;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.function.Function;
011import java.util.function.ToDoubleFunction;
012
013/** Searching utilities for collections. */
014public final class Search {
015  private Search() {
016    // utility class
017  }
018
019  /**
020   * Searches a sorted list for a key using binary search, comparing the key against a projection of
021   * each element. This is useful when elements are sorted by one of their properties and a bare key
022   * of that property's type is all that is available, which {@link
023   * java.util.Collections#binarySearch(List, Object, Comparator)} cannot do because it requires a
024   * key of the element type.
025   *
026   * <p>The list must be sorted in ascending order of the projected values according to the
027   * comparator. The result is undefined if it is not. If the list contains multiple elements whose
028   * projection equals the key, there is no guarantee which one is found.
029   *
030   * <p>This runs in O(log n) time for a {@link java.util.RandomAccess} list. For other lists, each
031   * probe is a {@link List#get(int)} and the search is correspondingly slower.
032   *
033   * @param <T> The element type of the list.
034   * @param <K> The type of the key and of the projected element values.
035   * @param list The list to search, sorted by the projected values.
036   * @param key The key to search for.
037   * @param comparator The comparator that orders projected values.
038   * @param projector A function that extracts the value to compare against the key from an element.
039   * @return The index of an element whose projection equals the key if one exists. Otherwise,
040   *     {@code -(insertion point) - 1}, where the insertion point is the index of the first element
041   *     whose projection is greater than the key, or the list size if there is none. The return
042   *     value is non-negative if and only if a match is found.
043   */
044  public static <T, K> int binarySearch(
045      List<? extends T> list,
046      K key,
047      Comparator<? super K> comparator,
048      Function<? super T, ? extends K> projector) {
049    int low = 0;
050    int high = list.size() - 1;
051
052    while (low <= high) {
053      int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
054      int cmp = comparator.compare(projector.apply(list.get(mid)), key);
055
056      if (cmp < 0) {
057        low = mid + 1;
058      } else if (cmp > 0) {
059        high = mid - 1;
060      } else {
061        return mid;
062      }
063    }
064
065    return -(low + 1);
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Searches a sorted list for a {@code double} key using binary search, comparing the key against
070   * a projection of each element. This avoids boxing the projected values, unlike {@link
071   * #binarySearch(List, Object, Comparator, Function)}.
072   *
073   * <p>The list must be sorted in ascending order of the projected values according to {@link
074   * Double#compare(double, double)}. The result is undefined if it is not. If the list contains
075   * multiple elements whose projection equals the key, there is no guarantee which one is found.
076   *
077   * <p>This runs in O(log n) time for a {@link java.util.RandomAccess} list. For other lists, each
078   * probe is a {@link List#get(int)} and the search is correspondingly slower.
079   *
080   * @param <T> The element type of the list.
081   * @param list The list to search, sorted by the projected values.
082   * @param key The key to search for.
083   * @param projector A function that extracts the value to compare against the key from an element.
084   * @return The index of an element whose projection equals the key if one exists. Otherwise,
085   *     {@code -(insertion point) - 1}, where the insertion point is the index of the first element
086   *     whose projection is greater than the key, or the list size if there is none. The return
087   *     value is non-negative if and only if a match is found.
088   */
089  public static <T> int binarySearch(
090      List<? extends T> list, double key, ToDoubleFunction<? super T> projector) {
091    int low = 0;
092    int high = list.size() - 1;
093
094    while (low <= high) {
095      int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
096      int cmp = Double.compare(projector.applyAsDouble(list.get(mid)), key);
097
098      if (cmp < 0) {
099        low = mid + 1;
100      } else if (cmp > 0) {
101        high = mid - 1;
102      } else {
103        return mid;
104      }
105    }
106
107    return -(low + 1);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Searches a sorted array for a key using binary search, comparing the key against a projection
112   * of each element. See {@link #binarySearch(List, Object, Comparator, Function)} for the full
113   * contract.
114   *
115   * @param <T> The element type of the array.
116   * @param <K> The type of the key and of the projected element values.
117   * @param array The array to search, sorted by the projected values.
118   * @param key The key to search for.
119   * @param comparator The comparator that orders projected values.
120   * @param projector A function that extracts the value to compare against the key from an element.
121   * @return The index of an element whose projection equals the key if one exists. Otherwise,
122   *     {@code -(insertion point) - 1}, where the insertion point is the index of the first element
123   *     whose projection is greater than the key, or the array length if there is none. The return
124   *     value is non-negative if and only if a match is found.
125   */
126  public static <T, K> int binarySearch(
127      T[] array,
128      K key,
129      Comparator<? super K> comparator,
130      Function<? super T, ? extends K> projector) {
131    return binarySearch(Arrays.asList(array), key, comparator, projector);
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Searches a sorted array for a {@code double} key using binary search, comparing the key against
136   * a projection of each element. This avoids boxing the projected values. See {@link
137   * #binarySearch(List, double, ToDoubleFunction)} for the full contract.
138   *
139   * @param <T> The element type of the array.
140   * @param array The array to search, sorted by the projected values.
141   * @param key The key to search for.
142   * @param projector A function that extracts the value to compare against the key from an element.
143   * @return The index of an element whose projection equals the key if one exists. Otherwise,
144   *     {@code -(insertion point) - 1}, where the insertion point is the index of the first element
145   *     whose projection is greater than the key, or the array length if there is none. The return
146   *     value is non-negative if and only if a match is found.
147   */
148  public static <T> int binarySearch(T[] array, double key, ToDoubleFunction<? super T> projector) {
149    return binarySearch(Arrays.asList(array), key, projector);
150  }
151}
